title: House and Hymn
author: K. M. Vasquez
blurb: Orsen Kavanagh, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
